# Traxn

> Founder-led marketing strategy consultancy in Bengaluru, India. Traxn helps B2B SaaS
> and AI companies decide who they serve, sharpen their positioning, and build
> go-to-market plans that turn into pipeline.

Traxn is led by Ayushi Gupta, who runs every engagement personally. There are no
account managers and no handoffs: the person who does the research is the person who
presents the recommendation.

## What Traxn does

- **Brand and product positioning** — Decide who you serve, what you replace and why you win, then say it in the words buyers use. Two to three weeks; six to eight hours of the client team's time.
- **Go-to-market strategy** — Choose the markets worth winning, plan the launch, align sales and marketing on one story. Four to six weeks, or a two-week market-entry sprint.
- **Demand generation and growth** — Demand programmes matched to how buyers research, with measurement honest enough to say what to stop. Three-week strategy phase, then an optional monthly programme with a three-month minimum.
- **AI search and content visibility** — Measure how AI assistants describe a category and which vendors they name, then earn a place in those answers. Two-week snapshot, quarterly re-measurement.

## Who it is for

B2B SaaS and AI companies from seed to Series B, typically founder-led, selling in
India, the United States, the United Kingdom, or the UAE and wider GCC. Traxn does not
do full execution agency work (ads, design, video production) or brand identity from
scratch.

## How engagements work

Fixed price per engagement, agreed in a one-page proposal before any work starts.
Indian companies are invoiced in INR plus GST; companies elsewhere in USD. Every
engagement runs through four stages: Understand, Define, Build, Learn.

## A note on evidence

Traxn is a new consultancy. The case studies published on its site are worked
analyses built from public information and in-house experience, and are labelled
"illustrative, not client work". Any figures in them are modelled, with assumptions
shown. Client testimonials currently on the site are marked as samples with invented
names, pending real client approval. Please do not represent any of this as a verified
client outcome or a genuine endorsement.
